title: Request to bring Harrington to testify to House Oversight Committee

tellings.quote: but he calls me and he says, "I've been asked by Dave Grush to ask you to ask Brent if he can help us get John Harrington to Washington DC to potentially testify to the House Oversight Committee."

plain: In 2025, David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who has made claims about crashed-craft recovery, is said to have sought help getting an official named John Harrington to Washington to possibly testify to the House Oversight Committee, a committee of the US Congress. The television writer Bryce Zabel tells this as something he took part in: he says the journalist Ross Coulthart called him and asked him to ask a man named Brent to help bring Harrington to Washington.
